P_sites.claim: TWO engine sites, and canTakeStatus is the wrong home for the status half
P_sites.status_half: applyStatus — because the announce needs `eff` (which canTakeStatus never receives) and because Safeguard's identical `-activate|TARGET|move: X` refusal already lives there
P_sites.volatile_half: the `a.kind==='yawn'` branch in the turn loop, above the apply and beside the Sweet Veil / Flower Veil `allyRefusesVolatile` refusal

P3_which_scoreboard.predicted: THE LAB MOVES. THE POOL SITS STILL.
P3_which_scoreboard.arithmetic: the scope measured 11 sleep clicks under Electric Terrain (upper bound 12) across the WHOLE 17,381-game store — 0.06% of games. Over 961 pool games that is under one expected event before any further conditioning, and `--steering empirical` samples P(move | species) rather than replaying those clicks, so the 11 does not translate. Electric Terrain itself is 237 field-starts of 17,381 = 1.4%, and the terrain must additionally be UP (5-turn window, no extender in this format) at the moment a sleep move is clicked at a GROUNDED body, inside a 12-turn cap.
